description.value: Dominion Bar + Kitchen is a full-service restaurant and bar in the lobby of Surrey's Civic Hotel, overlooking the city's Civic Plaza — one of the municipality's main gathering squares. The menu is built around locally sourced ingredients including Ocean Wise-certified seafood, Richmond eggs, and Langley chicken, paired with handcrafted cocktails, BC wines, and local craft beers. It operates across multiple dayparts from early breakfast through late-night service and offers a private dining room for groups.
